mechanism: Propylthiouracil may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of atazanavir, potentially increasing atazanavir levels, while atazanavir may affect propylthiouracil metabolism and thyroid function monitoring becomes complex in HIV patients.
action: Monitor thyroid function tests and atazanavir levels closely; consider alternative antiretroviral therapy if thyroid dysfunction worsens or atazanavir toxicity emerges.
